reason: The right page's numbered timeline, red warning callout and card sections give a clearer runbook hierarchy, while the left is plainer, though the right's #deploys chip wraps awkwardly on the phone.
The right page's progress bar, region cards with ahead/behind status and larger labeled chart read better at both widths, while the left chart is small and its phone chart drops axis ticks.
The right page's area chart, target-marked bars on a clear scale and flagged slow categories are more legible and polished, while the left's target label overlaps the 1.6 h bar label on the phone.
The right page's stacked bar, share-of-month chart and decision callout are clearer and well labeled at both widths, while the left's line chart has a truncated $42.7 label and a clipped axis break.
The left letter has a warm, well-set layout and a clean dates table, while the right is plain, though both are legible and free of defects.
The right page's calendar cards collapse the task text into a one-word-per-line column with the times and periods split out, which is a broken layout, while the left page's table is clean.
